transport: One canonical Higgs doublet, three active Dirac neutrinos with three right-handed partners, standard Yukawa beta functions and no new threshold; low-energy mass/angle inputs carried to a common weak scale. Numerical tolerances beyond the declared working box require separate matching.
geometric_condition: middle singular value squared = smallest times largest
optional_shared_shape: All three singular values proportional between the two sectors; independent normalizations.
